---
name: security-review
description: Perform an evidence based security review of source, workflows, dependencies, secrets, network handlers, permissions, paths, serialization, and releases.
---

Identify assets, actors, trust boundaries, untrusted inputs, privileged operations, and recovery paths.

Review command and packet authority, bounds, thread context, path containment, deserialization, workflow permissions, fork behavior, action pinning, dependency risk, secret handling, and artifact provenance.

Report concrete attack paths with severity and remediation. Verify fixes through deterministic checks. Route exploitable disclosures through private vulnerability reporting.
